linkedin.rule: Every post goes to BOTH Instagram and the Socius LinkedIn company page, as two separate Metricool posts.
linkedin.times: LinkedIn: weekdays only, 08:45 or 12:15 Europe/London, on the Instagram date or the next weekday.
linkedin.format: Same images. Carousels: linkedinData.publishImagesAsPDF=true with a documentTitle (swipeable document). Single image: normal image post.
linkedin.caption: Rewrite for LinkedIn: first person from Jordan where natural, a little longer and more considered, full https:// links (clickable), max 3 hashtags, never 'link in bio'.

monthly_post_budget.note: Metricool free plan: about 20 scheduled posts per calendar month, each network counts as one post. So ~10 calendar posts a month (one every ~3 days), each on IG + LinkedIn. Before scheduling, count posts already scheduled/published in Metricool for that month; if the budget would be exceeded, move the post to next month and tell Jordan. Jordan is happy to upgrade (Starter) if this proves limiting.
